items.title: Mistral Large 4
items.why: Staying up to date with major LLM model releases helps you know which state-of-the-art tools are available.
items.summary: Mistral has released its latest flagship frontier model, Mistral Large 4, offering upgraded reasoning capabilities.

items.title: Jakeschincariol/replica-skill
items.why: It offers hands-on AI workflow prompts that help you practice reverse-engineering and software development.
items.summary: A set of eleven free Claude skills designed to analyze existing software applications, reverse-engineer them, and rebuild their core logic.

items.title: Beam: Reflection's 501B open-weight model
items.why: It represents a notable milestone in open-source AI with a massive open-weight model being made publicly accessible.
items.summary: Reflection has open-sourced Beam, a massive 501-billion parameter open-weights language model.

items.title: allenv0/SCM
items.why: It is a practical local AI utility for searching your personal media using natural language.
items.summary: An open-source macOS utility that performs deep AI semantic search across photos and video frames stored in local folders.

items.title: DozenTwelve/Papermorph
items.why: It shows how generative AI can be applied to create engaging educational web interfaces.
items.summary: An AI tool that transforms text from books into interactive, narrated, and animated web experiences.

items.title: QingYunA/answer-me-with-html
items.why: It gives you an easy way to make AI agents format their output into readable HTML pages.
items.summary: A skill for AI agents that formats answers to complex questions into a clean, single-page web document.

items.title: StayLameBro/backburner
items.why: It is a clever local LLM utility that lets you combine your existing hardware devices to run large AI models.
items.summary: An open-source tool that offloads prompt processing to an iPhone over USB-C to run a 27B parameter LLM faster on a Mac.

items.title: elstongun/leviathan
items.why: It provides a practical open-source project showing how AI agents retain context over large datasets.
items.summary: A lightweight CLI tool that converts standard database files like JSONL and CSV into a searchable long-term memory system for AI agents.

items.title: Opus 5.5 agents discover two room-temperature magnetic semiconductor candidates
items.why: It highlights a real-world scientific breakthrough achieved by AI agents solving complex problems.
items.summary: Anthropic's Opus 5.5 AI agents autonomously identified two candidate materials for room-temperature magnetic semiconductors.

items.title: Utah to let AI examine patients and prescribe medication without human oversight
items.why: It is a major policy development showing how AI is being granted autonomous decision-making power in critical real-world fields.
items.summary: Utah has passed a policy allowing AI systems to evaluate medical patients and issue prescriptions without human doctor oversight.

items.title: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
items.why: It is one of the day's major international news developments involving high-level intelligence and treason charges.
items.summary: August Hanning, the former head of Germany's foreign intelligence agency, was taken into custody under suspicion of passing classified secrets to a foreign government.

items.title: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say
items.why: It covers an unprecedented and dramatic world news event involving legal and medical complications.
items.summary: A death row inmate in the US survived a failed lethal injection attempt and regained consciousness a week later.
